Freelance 3D illustrator based in London. Self-described as "London-based illustrator" on her site (hollyobj.com, Portfoliobox); LinkedIn headline reads "Freelance Design; Self-employed"; Behance lists her as available for freelance. Womp 3D announced her as Art Director (LinkedIn post, date unclear, possibly past or short contract) but her own self-maintained profiles show no current employer, so treated as stale. Work Status: Freelance confirmed from three self-maintained sources (site + LinkedIn + Behance). Ragged Edge is a freelance collaborator relationship, not employment.

Seniority: mid-career, approx. 5 years experience per Womp 3D announcement ("five years working in social and graphic design, as well as 3D skills"). Clients include The New Yorker, New York Times, Wall Street Journal, and The Guardian (editorial illustration), plus brand work for Ragged Edge (Omlet rebrand) and Womp 3D. Autonomy 3: capable independent freelancer taking editorial and brand commissions solo, but not operating at creative direction level; no evidence of leading teams or large projects.

Capabilities: Illustration (primary), 3D & motion (her distinctive medium is 3D-rendered illustration using tools like Womp, creating characters and scenes for editorial and brand contexts).
